games.name: Welcome to Roblox Building
games.desc:
A rewrite of "Welcome to Roblox Building", which was a sandbox building place hosted by Roblox around 2010-2016. 

This remaster of the game features more blocks, more baseplate customization, modernized interfaces, less exploits, save slots, and almost no limit to how much you can build!

This game is still a work in progress! Not all features have been fully polished and implemented yet. If you have any feedback, feel free to send a message to CloneTrooper1019! Thanks!

Special thanks to the team behind the original WTRB:

- Stickmasterluke
- HotThoth
- darthskrill
- timobius
- jahrblox
- tarabyte
